title: Morale Checks
content:
Morale is checked in two situations:

1. When a side first loses a member in combat
2. When half the group has been incapacitated

To check morale, roll 2d6. If the result is higher than the creature's morale score, it attempts to flee or surrender.

Retainers also check morale when their employer is killed or in extremely dangerous situations.

title: Getting Lost
content:
When traveling through wilderness, parties without a guide or reliable map must check for getting lost.

Chance of getting lost by terrain:
- Clear, grasslands: 1-in-6
- Forest, hills, mountains: 2-in-6
- Swamp, jungle, desert: 3-in-6

A lost party moves in a random direction for that day's travel. They remain lost until they either find a landmark, succeed on a subsequent getting lost check, or use magic to determine their location.
